text:
mika: Hey all — thinking of unplugging this weekend. Folk fair in the park on Saturday or a quiet cabin by the lake Sunday? Which camp are you in? :camping:
ben: Folk fair for me. Live banjo set + local cider. Might drag a picnic blanket. :apple:
alejandra: Cabin sounds heavenly. No phone, lots of books, maybe a slow hike. :mountain_snow:
joel: Both sound great. I can dog-sit if anyone needs a +1 for the cabin plan (Max loves hikes). @mika you going to bring marshmallows? :dog:
katie: If anyone's considering the ferry to the lake, here's the midday schedule I found:
```
Ferry 12:10 -> arrives 12:40
Ferry 14:00 -> arrives 14:30
Times are weekend-only, single-ride $6
```
ben: Ooh thanks @katie. Folk fair ends early so could still catch the 14:00 ferry and meet up at the cabin for sunset if people want to compromise? :thinking_face:
alejandra: That compromise is suspiciously brilliant. Folk tunes + cabin chill. I'm in if there's room for one more in the car. :raised_hands:
mika: I like that. Quick poll: hands for purely folk fair? purely cabin? hybrid (fair then ferry)?
ben: purely folk fair -> :one:
alejandra: purely cabin -> :two:
joel: hybrid -> :three: (I can bring the extra blanket)
katie: hybrid for me too. Bringing a thermos and marshmallows. :smile:
mika: Great — looks like hybrid is winning. I'll make a tiny spreadsheet for rides and snacks tomorrow and ping people. :slightly_smiling_face:
